official.status_note: The Batch-IV online registration window opened on 9 August 2026 and closed on 28 August 2026 at 1600 hours; the HEC Aptitude Test originally listed for 27 September 2026 was rescheduled to 19 September 2026 and answer keys for the tests held on that date have been published. HEC runs the scheme in successive batches and advertises future rounds on the Announcement page.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Published wording: "HEC will contribute up to a maximum of USD 4,000 per annum, or the equivalent amount in the applicable currency, towards tuition fees for a maximum period of two (02) years" for MS and "four (04) years" for PhD. "Any tuition fee exceeding this limit shall be covered through a tuition fee waiver or borne by the scholar."
benefits: Maintenance allowance of up to a maximum of USD 1,600 per month, or the approved stipend rate applicable to the country of study, payable for a maximum of 24 months (MS) and 48 months (PhD)
Tuition fee contribution of up to a maximum of USD 4,000 per annum, or the equivalent amount in the applicable currency, for a maximum of two (02) years (MS) and four (04) years (PhD)
Health insurance (where applicable) reimbursed on an actual-cost basis, up to a maximum of USD 600 per annum for two (02) years (MS) and four (04) years (PhD)
One economy-class round-trip air ticket reimbursed on an actual-cost basis, subject to a maximum of PKR 250,000 one-way journey
eligibility: Applicant must be a Pakistani / AJK National
MS: BS/BE/Masters or equivalent to 16 years of education in a relevant field of studies with a minimum CGPA 3.0 out of 4.0 in the semester system or first division in the annual system

PhD: minimum of eighteen years of education (MS/MPhil or equivalent); candidates with a 17-year foreign MSc/MS degree are also eligible subject to equivalence from the HEC A&A division at the time of application submission
A maximum of one second division (or equivalent grade) throughout the academic career prior to the terminal/final degree is permissible

Maximum age to apply (on the closing date): MS 30 and PhD 35 for all others; MS 35 and PhD 40 for employees of public-sector universities/colleges, R&D bodies, government or semi-government organisations. No age relaxation in any case

Applicants who previously availed an HEC-funded MS/MPhil scholarship are eligible only after a minimum residency period of two (02) years in Pakistan following completion of the MS/MPhil degree, and employees of public-sector universities/colleges, R&D bodies, government or semi-government organisations must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their organisation
requirements: Application submitted online through the HEC e-Services Scholarship Portal
Application processing fee of Rs. 3,000 deposited through 1LINK payment services
Admission in the foreign top-200 QS/THE ranked university is separate from the award and must be secured by the scholar

Candidates are required to fulfil the requirements of the host university to secure admission, which may include international GRE, TOEFL, IELTS etc.; candidates are advised to appear in these tests before interview/admission
Requests for amendment will not be entertained after submission of the online application
documents: No hard copy of the online application form or educational documents is required at the application stage
A duly signed printout of the application form along with the required supporting documents, requested only from shortlisted candidates
No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the employer for employees of public-sector universities/colleges, R&D bodies, government or semi-government organisations
HEC equivalence from the Attestation & Accreditation (A&A) division, provided at the time of application submission, for applicants holding a 17-year foreign MSc/MS degree

Valid HEC Aptitude Test (HAT) score; a valid existing score on the closing date may be used, HAT scores remain valid for two years and the best score is considered where an applicant has multiple valid scores
At the award stage: acceptance and declaration, deed of agreement and surety bond, and undertaking on details of service and assets, using the templates published by HEC
selection_criteria: Selection of candidates will be made on merit based on HEC Aptitude Test scores and interview results, subject to the approved provincial quotas of the Government of Pakistan and slot availability thematic-area wise
Only shortlisted candidates who have passed the HEC aptitude test will be called for interviews

Candidates holding confirmed unconditional admission in thematic areas for the upcoming semester (Fall 2026) in a Top 200 QS/THE-ranked university will be exempted from the scholarship test/interview, subject to meeting the prescribed eligibility requirements

Candidates are required to opt for foreign universities (Top 200 QS/THE World University Rankings) and countries of their choice in the online application form; HEC reserves the right to re-allocate any university or country to the candidate
Candidates are required to make sure that their field of subject is offered in their choice of country/university, otherwise the candidate will not be considered for interview/scholarship
HEC will share the list of potential candidates with the partner agencies/universities for the placement of scholars
coverage: The maintenance allowance covers accommodation, course literature, visa-related expenses, and other approved living expenses
Tuition fees up to the maximum of USD 4,000 per annum for the funded duration, with any excess to be covered through a tuition fee waiver or borne by the scholar
Health insurance (where applicable) reimbursed on an actual-cost basis up to USD 600 per annum
One economy-class round-trip air ticket reimbursed on an actual-cost basis, subject to a maximum of PKR 250,000 one-way journey
application_method: Create/login to the HEC e-Services Scholarship Portal and complete the online application
Deposit the Rs. 3,000 application processing fee through 1LINK payment services
Submit the application before the deadline; no printed application is to be sent initially
Sit the HEC Aptitude Test (HAT) conducted by the Education Testing Council (ETC), Pakistan
Attend the interview if shortlisted; only shortlisted applicants are contacted to submit the duly signed printout with supporting documents
official.application_route: Online only, through the HEC e-Services Scholarship Portal (Overseas Scholarship for MS/PhD Studies batch), with the Rs. 3,000 processing fee paid via 1LINK payment services.
official.citizenship_residency: Applicant must be a Pakistani / AJK National.
official.international_eligibility: No - the award is restricted to Pakistani and AJK nationals; the degree is completed at foreign Top 200 QS/THE ranked universities abroad.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Scholarships are offered only in eight published priority areas: (1) Digital Transformation & Emerging Technologies, (2) Energy, Climate Change & Environment, (3) Agriculture, Food Security & Agri-Tech, (4) Health, Biotechnology & Life Sciences, (5) Engineering & Advanced Manufacturing, (6) Natural & Physical Sciences, (7) Social Sciences, Business & Governance, (8) Interdisciplinary & Strategic Areas. PhD scholarships are offered in selected fields whereas MS/M.Phil scholarships are offered in specified thematic areas. Employees of public-sector universities/colleges, R&D bodies, government or semi-government organisations must submit an NOC.
official.duration: Maintenance allowance payable for a maximum of 24 months (MS) and 48 months (PhD); tuition fee contribution for a maximum of two (02) years (MS) and four (04) years (PhD); health insurance reimbursed for a maximum of two (02) years (MS) and four (04) years (PhD).
official.description: The Higher Education Commission (HEC), Pakistan invites applications from outstanding Pakistani and AJK nationals for MS/MPhil and PhD scholarships under the project "Overseas Scholarship for MS/M.Phil Leading to PhD in Selected Fields (Phase-III)". The scholarship aims to develop highly qualified human resources by providing opportunities to study at Top 200 QS/THE Ranked Universities across the world in strategically important disciplines that contribute to Pakistan's socio-economic development. Payments to scholars are made in accordance with the project's approved financial provisions, which cover stipends, tuition fees and health insurance.

verification.notes: All figures and rules were taken from the awarding body's own hec.gov.pk Phase-III pages (Tuition Fee and Stipend Details, Introduction, Eligibility Criteria, How to Apply, Announcement). The website was unreachable directly from this environment despite six attempts (repeated transport/connection errors on hec.gov.pk and www.hec.gov.pk), so the official page text was read through search-engine indexing of the hec.gov.pk domain; the USD 1,600 / USD 4,000 / USD 600 / PKR 250,000 figures were consistent across the official pages, and the Batch-IV dates were consistent with the HEC announcements listing answer keys for the 19 September 2026 test. Confidence is marked low per protocol because direct page retrieval was not possible.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a partially funded, government-run overseas award: the stipend is capped at USD 1,600 a month and tuition at USD 4,000 a year, so the full bill of a top-200 QS/THE university will rarely be met by HEC alone, and any tuition gap is explicitly the scholar's responsibility unless a fee waiver is secured. Admission is separate from the award and must be won by the candidate, which makes early GRE/TOEFL/IELTS preparation and a realistic university shortlist essential. Selection is quota-based with thematic-area slots, so a strong HEC Aptitude Test score inside one of the eight priority fields matters as much as the academic record. Batch-IV closed on 28 August 2026 and its test has already been held, so the next entry point is a future batch announced on HEC's Announcement page.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Pakistani/AJK nationals under 30 (MS) or 35 (PhD) with a 3.0+ CGPA, a single second division at most, who can personally fund a tuition gap and want a structured route into a top-200 QS/THE university.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your degree sits squarely inside one of the eight thematic areas before anything else - off-theme applications are not considered for interview
Register and sit the HAT in the correct category and keep the score valid; scores last two years and the best of multiple valid scores counts
Sit GRE/TOEFL/IELTS early enough that scores exist before the interview and admission stage, as HEC advises
If you work for a public-sector university, college, R&D body or government organisation, start the NOC process months before the closing date
Budget for the tuition gap and secure evidence of a fee waiver or your own funding if your target university charges more than USD 4,000 a year
Review the online form carefully before submitting, because amendment requests are not entertained after submission
common_rejection_risks: Choosing a university or country that does not actually teach your subject within the thematic area
A second division anywhere in the academic career before the terminal degree, or a CGPA below 3.0/4.0
Crossing the age limit on the closing date - HEC grants no relaxation in any case
Falling below the provincial-quota or thematic-area slot cutoff even with a respectable HAT score
Incomplete applications, or an unpaid Rs. 3,000 processing fee, which HEC states will not be entertained
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Tuition above USD 4,000 per year (for up to two years MS / four years PhD) unless a fee waiver is secured, any shortfall where living costs in high-cost destinations exceed USD 1,600 a month, visa and travel extras beyond the reimbursed economy ticket, and study materials not covered by the maintenance allowance.
applicant_utility.document_audit: HEC publishes no application-stage document checklist, so do not post anything - the signed printout and supporting documents arrive only if you are shortlisted. The real traps are the employer NOC for public-sector employees, the A&A equivalence letter if your MS is a 17-year foreign degree, and holding a HAT score that is still within its two-year validity on the closing date.
alerts: Batch-IV closed on 28 August 2026 at 1600 hours and the HAT was held on 19 September 2026, so there is no open window today - watch the Announcement page for the next batch rather than assuming a rolling cycle
HEC reserves the right to re-allocate your chosen university or country, and to postpone or cancel the test and amend the schedule
The stipend payable may be the approved rate for your country of study rather than the USD 1,600 maximum, so model your budget on the country rate, not the ceiling
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply online on the HEC e-Services Scholarship Portal and pay Rs. 3,000 via 1LINK, then sit the HAT; shortlisted candidates face an interview and only then are asked to produce the signed printout with supporting documents.
